subject.title: fix(gateway): add per-request cancellation to prevent late node.invoke dispatch

question: Should Gateway add an explicit per-request deadline/cancellation contract from the originating client rather than approximate caller lifetime with the plugin approval maximum?
rationale: Current request frames do not communicate the caller’s configurable timeout, while the canonical security requirement calls for one authoritative lifetime across the client waiter, server approval, and node dispatch transition.

options.title: Add authoritative cancellation
options.body: Negotiate or propagate the actual per-request deadline or cancel event, bind it to the originating connection, and make cancellation lose once node dispatch begins.

options.title: Accept disconnect-only hardening
options.body: Narrow this PR to socket-close cancellation and explicitly leave caller-local timeout cancellation as separately tracked protocol work.

options.title: Pause for lifecycle design
options.body: Hold the PR until Gateway and security owners agree on request-state ownership and mixed-version protocol behavior.

recommendation.title: Add authoritative cancellation
recommendation.body: Negotiate or propagate the actual per-request deadline or cancel event, bind it to the originating connection, and make cancellation lose once node dispatch begins.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the canonical issue’s required security contract and has the strongest relevant Gateway lifecycle history.
